name: The Hand of Gul’dan

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: An Earthen Ring request brings the adventurer to Shadowmoon Valley’s damaged ground. The Alliance and Horde have different starting earthmenders, so this account keeps its first step with the shared task: help the troubled spirits. Torlok’s work asks more than force. The story begins among black rock and green-lit fissures with a question about repair—whether those who harmed the land can still answer the elements that remain within it.
